summary_bullets: Avoid redundant gh release edit when the selected release is already latest and not a pre-release.
Document RELEASE_ALREADY_LATEST and align the private release skill with the new early-exit contract.
commit_message:
Skip promote-latest-release gh edit when release already latest

No API mutation when the newest non-draft release is already isPrerelease=false and isLatest=true; emit RELEASE_ALREADY_LATEST for operators and docs.
